text:
meera: Quick idea 11 Start a recurring 'shift-change sync' for oncall handoffs + a fast triage review. Keep it short and action-focused. Thinking 30m, weekly, Tue 10:00am PT. Proposed attendees and agenda below.

alex: Weekly 30m sounds right. Twice a week will eat cycles unless there's sustained incident volume. :+1:

sam: I can run the first facilitation rotation if we rotate. Also let's post the live incident list in the channel 10min before the call so the meeting can dive straight into blockers.

jordan: Attendees (base): current oncall, next-oncall (shadow), SRE lead, incident commander when applicable. If any open sev1/sev2, ping the relevant eng leads to join.

taylor: Please create a calendar invite that auto-adds the oncall group and SRE. Add a 5-min reminder and a short invite description with the attendance rules.

meera: Draft agenda I'm thinking (30m):
```
0-6m: Handoff summary (state, recent deploys, known flakes)
6-18m: Incident roundup (active sev1/2 first, then sev3s if time)
18-26m: Actions & owners (clear assignees + ETA)
26-30m: Escalations / followups + confirm next facilitator
Notes: facilitator runs the meeting, updates the tracker, assigns actions. Next-oncall should stay for at least first 10m.
```

alex: Can we have oncall-bot post a pre-meeting digest 10 minutes prior with a one-line summary + links to runbooks? That will speed the triage.

oncall-bot: I will post an "Open incidents digest" 10 minutes before the recurring event. Please keep incident summaries short in the tracker for clarity.

sam: Also propose a handoff checklist snippet we can copy into the tracker:
- recent alert volume (24h)
- recent rollbacks or config changes
- ongoing investigations and assigned owners
- any postponed postmortem tasks

jordan: Escalation rule: if an incident is sev1 or affects >2 critical components, require eng leads to be notified and to join the sync (can join remotely). I'll add this to the invite text.

taylor: Small ops request: keep design discussions out of this sync unless they're directly blocking an incident. Use #eng-design or a separate thread for that so we don't blow the 30m.

meera: Decision recap: recurring weekly Tue 10:00am PT, 30 minutes. Facilitation rotates weekly (sam runs first). Invite will auto-add oncall group + SRE, include oncall-bot digest 10m prior, and include the escalation rule. Agenda pinned in channel. First meeting next Tue at 10am PT. If incident volume spikes we'll reassess cadence. Speak now or DM if concerns. :thumbsup:
